entities.summary: David Jakob Ullström is a Swedish former professional ice hockey player. He last played with Schwenninger Wild Wings in the Deutsche Eishockey Liga (DEL). He was selected by the New York Islanders in the 4th round of the 2008 NHL Entry Draft.
